# apicurio_artifacts (Data Source)

Searches artifacts across the registry (`GET /search/artifacts`). Every filter is evaluated by the server and all filters must match: `group_id`, `artifact_id` and `artifact_type` match exactly; `description` is a substring match; `name` is an exact, case-sensitive match from Apicurio Registry 3.1 (a case-sensitive substring match on 3.0); each label is required, with an empty value meaning "any value". All pages are fetched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every artifact of a group, newest first.
data "apicurio_artifacts" "payments" {
  group_id = "payments"
  order_by = "created_on"
  order    = "desc"
}

# Production Avro schemas of one team, anywhere in the registry: every label
# must match; an empty value accepts any value of that key.
data "apicurio_artifacts" "prod_avro" {
  artifact_type = "AVRO"
  labels = {
    env  = "prod"
    team = ""
  }
}

output "payments_artifact_ids" {
  value = [for a in data.apicurio_artifacts.payments.artifacts : a.artifact_id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `artifact_id` (String) Only the artifact with this id (exact).
- `artifact_type` (String) Artifact type, for example `AVRO`.
- `description` (String) Substring of the description.
- `group_id` (String) Only artifacts of this group.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels the artifacts must carry (all of them). An empty value matches any value of the key. Keys and values of this filter cannot contain `:`, because the registry splits each `key:value` on a colon (3.0 to 3.2 on the first one, 3.3 on the last one).
- `name` (String) Name filter (exact and case-sensitive from 3.1, substring on 3.0).
- `order` (String) `asc` or `desc`.
- `order_by` (String) Sort key: `artifact_id`, `artifact_type`, `created_on`, `group_id`, `modified_on`, `name`. Default: the server's order (by name).

### Read-Only

- `artifacts` (Attributes List) Matching artifacts, in the server's order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--artifacts))
- `id` (String) The search URL.
